arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.description: Play Cashy Tower, Cashy Invaders and Cashy Bubbles in the Cashy Arcade.
arcade.line: The machines are in. Pick a game.
arcade.mascotAlt: Cashy, a banknote in sunglasses and a leather jacket, playing a Cashy Arcade cabinet.

games.title: Cashy Tower
games.description: Play Cashy Tower: run, bounce off the walls and see how high you can climb.
games.line: Run, bounce off the walls and chain combos. How high can you go?
games.hint: Click the game, then use the keyboard: ← → or A D to move, Space, W or ↑ to jump.
games.phoneNote: Phone controls are coming. For now, play on a computer.

games.title: Cashy Invaders
games.description: Play Cashy Invaders: Cashy throws cash at the rival coins. How many waves can you clear?
games.line: Cashy throws cash at the rival coins. How many waves can you clear?
games.hint: Click the game, then use the keyboard: ← → or A D to move, Space to throw cash, P to pause. On a phone, use the buttons under the game.

games.title: Cashy Bubbles
games.description: Play Cashy Bubbles: match three coins to pop them, and beat the clock before the rows reach the street.
games.line: Match three coins to pop them. Beat the clock.
games.hint: Click the game, then aim with ← → or the mouse and fire with Space or a click. P pauses. On a phone, drag to aim and let go to fire.
